assistant.skills.shipped.boardHygiene: Tidy the board as the Assistant: duplicates, unrecorded answers, stale blocked reasons. Use when asked to tidy the board.
assistant.skills.shipped.cardLoop: Work through cards in turn as their builder or reviewer, waiting at no cost. Use when told to work through or review cards (one or several) as a builder or reviewer, or given rounds.
assistant.skills.shipped.coordinateAgent: Run work across the workspace's agents as the Assistant: cards, briefs, starting agents, waiting, handing over, stalled cards. Use when asked to get agents working, start or continue a card, or check progress.
assistant.skills.shipped.generalist: General work: understand, change carefully, prove it, report honestly. Use when no other skill fits, not for inbox lines.
assistant.skills.shipped.handover: Write a handover so a later session or another agent can carry on cold. Use when asked to wrap up for later, hand over or stop for the day. Readying a branch to merge is merge-ready.
assistant.skills.shipped.journal: Keep your journal as the Assistant while it is on - what to write, recalling, superseding, the weekly digest and the scope. Use when something worth remembering happens, before deciding from memory, or when asked for a handover.
assistant.skills.shipped.licenceAudit: Audit the licences of what ships: dependencies, vendored files, installer parts. Use when releasing or adding assets.
assistant.skills.shipped.mergeReady: Get a branch ready to merge and merge it when asked, through the merge slot: commit, run the checks, compare with the base. Use when asked to finish up, ready a branch, or merge one ("merge X into Y", "merge this lane").
assistant.skills.shipped.pickUp: Continue earlier work from its handover, checking it against the current state. Use when asked to continue, resume or pick up previous work, or to read a handover. Not for every new session.
assistant.skills.shipped.reviewAgentWork: Review another agent's work (a card in Review, a branch, commits or uncommitted changes) and report findings without changing it. Use when asked to review, check or verify work.
assistant.skills.shipped.runLanes: Run a team as the Assistant: builder and reviewer lanes on card loops, planned by files, briefed and watched to their end. Use when there are three or more agents or several builder and reviewer pairs, when asked for lanes, or woken about one.
assistant.skills.shipped.splitWork: Plan whether and how to divide a task between agents without conflicts, and save the plan. Use when asked how to split work between agents, to parallelise it, or to run several agents on it. Plans only: starting agents is separate.
assistant.skills.shipped.triageReport: Turn a reported problem into a card with evidence as the Assistant: cause first, then duplicates. Use when the user reports a problem.
assistant.skills.shipped.tuneSettings: Explain and suggest Combwork's settings as the Assistant; change one only when the user agrees. Use when asked what a setting does or how to make Combwork behave differently, or when one would fix what you see.
assistant.skills.shipped.useCombworkApi: A Combwork tool's cases in detail (tools.md), and Combwork's HTTP API for scripts. Use when a tool's description isn't enough, or to automate Combwork over HTTP: board and notes work uses the tools.
assistant.skills.shipped.workOnCard: Carry a card from Combwork's task board through its work, from Active to Review with a summary. Use when given a card to work on ("work on AM-12", a card Combwork started you on, more work on one back from Review). Not for reviewing one, nor a card loop (card-loop).
assistant.skills.shipped.workspaceNote: Record a lasting decision, convention or gotcha in the workspace's shared notes. Use when asked to remember or document something for later, or when other agents will need what you learned. Not for work in progress.

Each goes to the project agents (every agent in every project, of every provider), to the Assistant, or to both, as the audience in its SKILL.md says (the project agents if it says none). Combwork copies them for each session when it starts, so edits reach new sessions. Add, edit and delete them in the Skills view.

The workspace's are for every project, a project's are its own (kept in its .combwork, out of git). Export one to share it as a file.

assistant.undo.why.agentAdded: An agent it added stays: remove it in the project's agents if it isn't wanted.
assistant.undo.why.agentStopped: An agent it stopped isn't started again by undo: start it if it should run.
assistant.undo.why.ask: Its question stays under For you: answer or dismiss it there.
assistant.undo.why.cannot: Its request stays under For you: answer or dismiss it there.
assistant.undo.why.cardPlace: The card's place in its column isn't put back.
assistant.undo.why.cardsOrder: The cards' order isn't put back.
assistant.undo.why.comment: A comment stays: undo doesn't take back what was said.
assistant.undo.why.connectionChanged: A connection it changed isn't changed back: edit it in Settings → Accounts & Connections.
assistant.undo.why.connectionMade: A connection it made stays: remove it in Settings → Accounts & Connections if it isn't wanted.
assistant.undo.why.context: The doc sections to read first stay as set.
assistant.undo.why.decision: A decision it recorded stays: only you change or remove decisions.
assistant.undo.why.declarePaths: The paths it declared stay with the card.
assistant.undo.why.freshRetried: A lane agent's new conversation tried again isn't stopped by undo: end the lane if it isn't wanted.
assistant.undo.why.handOver: A hand-over can't be undone: the work went to the other agent.
assistant.undo.why.laneEnded: A lane that ended stays ended: start it again if it should go on.
assistant.undo.why.laneReorderNow: A card a lane reorder applied now put back stays in Todo: undo puts back only the lane's order.
assistant.undo.why.message: A message that was sent can't be taken back.
assistant.undo.why.nothing: It changed nothing undo puts back.
assistant.undo.why.projectClosed: A project it closed stays closed: open it again if it is wanted.
assistant.undo.why.projectMade: A project it made stays: remove it from Combwork if it isn't wanted.
assistant.undo.why.projectOpened: A project it opened stays open: close it if it isn't wanted.
assistant.undo.why.prompt: A prompt that was sent can't be taken back.
assistant.undo.why.putBack: Its reason stays as a comment.
assistant.undo.why.queuePaused: A merge queue it paused stays paused: resume it if it should run.
assistant.undo.why.queueResumed: A merge queue it resumed isn't paused again: pause it if it shouldn't run.
assistant.undo.why.removedFromQueue: Taking it out of the merge queue stays in the card's work: it is queued again only by Retry merge or a new approval.
assistant.undo.why.reportMerge: The merge it reported stays in the card's work.
assistant.undo.why.request: Its request to the builder stays as a comment.
assistant.undo.why.retriedMerge: Its Retry merge stays in the card's work.
assistant.undo.why.slotReleased: A slot it released isn't kept or held again: the next work that needs a slot may take it.
assistant.undo.why.start: Its start stays in the card's work: undo moves the card back, it doesn't unstart it.
assistant.undo.why.startReview: The review it started stays in the card's work.
assistant.undo.why.submit: Its submission stays in the card's work.
assistant.undo.why.teamPaused: A team it paused stays paused: resume it if it should go on.
assistant.undo.why.teamResumed: A team it resumed isn't paused again: pause it if it should wait.
assistant.undo.why.templateCards: The cards and lanes of the agents a template replaced stay as the load left them (cards put back, lanes ended): undo doesn't give them back.
assistant.undo.why.verdict: Its verdict stays in the card's work, and its round with it.
assistant.undo.why.withdrawn: Messages it withdrew aren't sent again.
